Czesław stands at the bathroom mirror during shaving. He is preparing to deliver an intense, confrontational monologue to his own reflection, but this pass is only for later lip-sync.

His lips remain fully closed for the entire shot. No speaking, no mouth opening, no visible articulation, no smiling with parted lips.

Use only subtle facial acting: his eyes slowly harden, his brows tighten slightly, and his gaze locks onto his own reflection with growing suspicion and restrained challenge. A tiny shift of the jaw under closed lips, a faint narrowing of the eyes, minimal nostril tension, and very small changes in posture. He briefly pauses the shaving motion, studies himself, then slightly tilts his head as if silently asking a provocative question.

Keep the performance controlled, serious and psychologically tense, not exaggerated, not comedic in expression. The humor comes from Czesław treating the moment with complete sincerity.

The razor and shaving brush remain naturally in his hands. Very small hand movement only. No sudden gestures. No camera movement. No zoom. prompts.animation:
Static cinematic shot, preserve the exact framing, bathroom layout, mirror geometry, lighting, wardrobe, facial identity and all visible objects from the source image.

Czesław has just finished the monologue. His hands are lowered out of frame. He does not continue shaving. He stands completely still and looks directly into his own eyes in the mirror.

His lips remain fully closed. No speaking, no mouth movement, no smile.

Use only very subtle microexpressions: the tension slowly leaves his brows, his eyes become slightly empty and tired, and his face settles into a quiet mixture of sadness, calm and emotional exhaustion. He holds the gaze for several seconds without blinking too much. A tiny breath through the nose, a minimal lowering of the shoulders, and an almost imperceptible softening around the eyes.

The performance must feel psychologically heavy, restrained and sincere, never melodramatic. He should look as if the confrontation with his reflection has suddenly ended and left only silence.

Add an extremely slow, nearly invisible 2% push-in toward his reflected face. No other camera movement. No object movement. No morphing, no facial drift, no changing glasses, no altered foam pattern, no extra limbs, no mirror inconsistencies. Warm dim bathroom lighting, realistic mirror physics, hyperrealistic cinematic motion, 16:9.
